name: Gura
source:
One of the Black Knights, whose figure is a giant male humanoid with a club as its weapon.
[spoiler]Being an apostle of Index and a subordinate of [url=https://vndb.org/c3156]Georgius of the Rainbow[/url], he fought with the other members of the Punishment Squad against Liselotte in the past; and although he perished, Gula was revived afterwards by [url=https://vndb.org/c3152]Misao[/url] using a artificial body.
His Index name is "Samson of the War Hammer".[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://11eyes.fandom.com/wiki/Gula]11eyes wiki[/url]]
